nkg2c_3cdg_homolog_substitution_audit.structural_mechanism_note: All 6 NKG2A->NKG2C ectodomain substitutions lie >4.5 A from HLA-E/B2M/peptide in PDB:3CDG (closest is Ile225 at 5.57 A and loop residues Ser167/Ile168/Ser170 at 5.90-5.97 A), whereas Ile168 (3.61 A) and Ser170 (3.38 A) directly pack against CD94 Chain J at the heterodimer interface—matching Kaiser et al. 2008 (PMID:18448674) that NKG2A/NKG2C affinity divergence is governed allosterically by the NKG2 167-170 (NKG2C 165-168) heterodimer loop orientation rather than direct P8-NKG2 contact.

vmaprtlvl_vs_vmaprtlfl_nkg2a_nkg2c_selec.scope_and_limitations_note: In PDB:3CDG, all P8-Phe8 heavy-atom contacts (24 in copy 1 P->J/K, 21 in copy 2 Q->E/F) are to the shared CD94 subunit (copy 1 J: J:SER111, J:GLN112, J:PHE114, J:ASN156, J:ASN158; copy 2 E: E:PHE114, E:ASN156, E:ASN158, E:ASN160) and 0 are to NKG2A; furthermore, deleting Phe ring atoms (CD1/CD2/CE1/CE2/CZ) is an atom-truncation diagnostic (leaving 2 and 1 contacts), not a modeled Val8 rotamer. Therefore, 3CDG coordinates alone do NOT provide an atomic proof of NKG2A-over-NKG2C selectivity. Primary SPR references report ~4.6-6.5-fold receptor-intrinsic CD94/NKG2A vs CD94/NKG2C selectivity on VMAPRTLFL (Kaiser et al. 2008 PMID:18448674 Table 1: WT NKG2A K_D = 0.8 +/- 0.055 uM vs WT NKG2C K_D = 5.2 +/- 0.2 uM [6.5x], with loop swap NKG2C[165-168SIIS] restoring K_D = 0.9 +/- 0.1 uM; Vales-Gomez et al. 1999 PMID:10428963 Table I: NKG2A K_D = 2.33 uM vs NKG2C K_D = 10.77 uM [4.6223x] for VMAPRTLFL, and NKG2A K_D = 7.35 uM for HLA-Cw*0302 VMAPRTLIL [vs >=75.30 uM for HLA-Cw*0402 VMEPRTLIL] / 11.23 uM for HLA-B*0702 VMAPRTVLL), while exact covalent single-chain HLA-E*01:03(VMAPRTLVL) trimer affinity requires direct Stage-0 SPR and HCMV+ NKG2C+ adaptive NK validation (AUDIT-REF).

Kaiser et al. 2008 (PMID:18448674 Table 1) measured HLA-G leader VMAPRTLFL (WT CD94/NKG2A K_D = 0.8 +/- 0.055 uM, WT CD94/NKG2C K_D = 5.2 +/- 0.2 uM, loop-swap NKG2C[165-168SIIS] K_D = 0.9 +/- 0.1 uM), Vales-Gomez et al. 1999 (PMID:10428963 Table I) measured VMAPRTLFL (2.33 vs 10.77 uM [4.6223x]), HLA-Cw*0302 VMAPRTLIL (7.35 uM vs >=75.30 uM for HLA-Cw*0402 VMEPRTLIL), and HLA-B*0702 VMAPRTVLL (11.23 uM), and Lin et al. 2023 (PMID:37264229 Supplementary Table 1) measured soluble refolded HLA-E*01:03 with non-covalent VMAPRTLVL (CD94/NKG2A K_D = 2.10 uM [95% CI 1.93-2.28] vs CD94/NKG2C K_D = 6.52 uM [6.41-6.63], ~3.1x selectivity), SP-1C VMAPRTLIL (1.33 vs 4.35 uM), and SP-2C VMAPRTLLL (1.70 vs 4.97 uM); however, exact covalent HLA-E*01:03(VMAPRTLVL) single-chain trimer (SCT) K_D with the (G4S)3/(G4S)4 L1 linker remains unmeasured (None) and requires direct Stage-0 SPR and HCMV+ NKG2C+ adaptive NK / HLA-E-restricted TCR donor-panel testing (AUDIT-REF, AUDIT-REF & AUDIT-REF).

designed_vs_crystallized_cd47_sequence_i.crystal_2JJS_chainC_pca1_edman_and_lcms_: Mature CD47 Gln19 (2JJS Chain C residue 1) is converted to N-terminal 5-oxoproline / pyroglutamate (HETATM PCA1, -17.03 Da via NH3 loss; catalyzed enzymatically in cells by glutaminyl cyclase QPCTL per Logtenberg et al. 2019 Nat Med PMID:30833751 alongside low-rate spontaneous cyclization), which lacks a free alpha-amino group and blocks phenylisothiocyanate (PITC) Edman degradation unless enzymatically deblocked with pyroglutamate aminopeptidase (PGP, which excises N-terminal pGlu to expose Leu2 for Edman sequencing rather than reverting pGlu to Gln), whereas intact/top-down LC-MS directly resolves the intact-chain -17.03 Da mass shift (AUDIT-REF & AUDIT-REF).
designed_vs_crystallized_cd47_sequence_i.structural_and_thiol_qualification_note: Full-length native CD47 forms a long-range inter-domain disulfide between IgV Cys33 (mature Cys15) and Cys263 at the extracellular loop / transmembrane boundary, whereas soluble crystal structures 2JJS (Hatherley et al. 2008 PMID:18657508), 4CMM (Hatherley et al. 2014 PMID:24550402), and 4KJY (Weiskopf et al. 2013 PMID:23722425) mutated Cys33->Gly (mature C15G) to prevent unpaired-thiol dimerization in soluble expression, and our designed CD47-IgV-GPI retains wild-type Cys33 (following Xu et al. 2024 Cell Rep Med PMID:38508139 membrane-anchored CD47-IgV). Therefore, soluble C15G crystal coordinates do not settle the free-thiol/disulfide state or membrane orientation of wild-type Cys33 CD47-IgV-GPI; Stage-0 pre-pilot must compare wild-type Cys33 vs C33G CD47-IgV-GPI via non-reducing SDS-PAGE, Ellman/maleimide free-thiol labeling, PI-PLC sensitivity, and SIRPa V1/V2/V8 binding.

r01_c_terminal_tpt2a_tail_and_rcl_suicid.rcl_low_plddt_and_high_pae_coordinate_un: Because AF-P50453-F1 predicts mobile RCL residues at low local coordinate confidence (residues 335-350 coordinate mean pLDDT = 53.30; recognition loop 335-345 coordinate mean = 36.21 [min 25.48 at Cys335, 29.20 at P1'-Cys341, max 59.00 at Ser345]; hinge-to-P3' loop 322-348 coordinate mean = 48.36; P1-Glu340 = 31.52, P1'-Cys341 = 29.20; global coordinate mean = 91.16 [AFDB v6 summary API metadata = 91.19; AF-P10144-F1 global coordinate mean = 92.41, API summary = 92.44]) and high inter-domain positional uncertainty relative to the serpin beta-sheet core (RCL 335-345 vs core 1-322 mean PAE = 27.29 A; aligned core 1-322 scored RCL 335-345 mean PAE = 15.20 A; single rigid domain 1-325), static Pro376->RCL heavy-atom clearances (26.13 A [28.57 A from Pro376.C] to 335-345, 12.55 A [15.07 A from Pro376.C] to s1C Cys350, 10.40 A [11.21 A from Pro376.C; 12.02 A CA-CA] to hinge Val322) are accompanied by 15.20-27.29 A AlphaFold directional expected positional error (PAE, which is an expected pairwise alignment error in Angstroms rather than a calibrated symmetric +/- probabilistic confidence interval) and are order-of-magnitude geometric priors that cannot substitute for Decision Experiment #3 recombinant GzmB k_ass and SI measurements (S55R2-D3-05, AUDIT-REF, AUDIT-REF & AUDIT-REF).
r01_c_terminal_tpt2a_tail_and_rcl_suicid.structural_and_conformational_uncertaint: In unmodified AF-P50453-F1, Pro376 is 34.26 A from P1-Glu340 CA, 12.02 A from proximal-hinge Val322 CA, and 24.05 A (C-terminal sheet 372-376 Phe373.CE1<->Ser345.CB; 26.13 A Pro376-only Pro376.CG<->Ser345.CB; 28.57 A from peptide-bond anchor Pro376.C<->Ser345.CB) from RCL recognition residues 335-345 (21.38 A from 372-376 / 24.20 A Pro376-only to 337-346 via Gly346.O; 9.77 A from 372-376 [Phe373.CD1<->Cys350.C] / 12.55 A Pro376-only [Pro376.CD<->Cys350.O] / 15.07 A Pro376.C across full mobile RCL 335-350 including s1C anchor Cys350; 7.96 A from 372-376 [Phe373.CD2<->Val322.CG2] / 10.40 A Pro376-only [Pro376.OXT<->Val322.O] / 11.21 A Pro376.C to proximal hinge 318-334; unmodified serpin-intrinsic heavy-atom distances; no bound SERPINB9:Granzyme B complex structure is claimed). The mobile RCL has low local prediction confidence (residues 335-350 mean pLDDT = 53.30, 335-345 mean pLDDT = 36.21, Glu340 = 31.52, Cys341 = 29.20); while the 21-aa WLC RMS extension (23.58 A) is below both the 24.05 A (372-376) and 28.57 A (Pro376.C anchor) P6-P5' recognition-loop clearances, it exceeds the 9.77 A / 15.07 A s1C (Cys350) and 7.96 A / 11.21 A proximal-hinge (Val322) clearances, and its 73.50 A contour upper bound (as well as 26-aa 91.0 A and 50-aa 175.0 A contours) exceeds 24.05 A. Whether the 21-aa GSG-P2A stub perturbs S->R serpin loop insertion must be resolved empirically by measuring k_ass and SI against recombinant human Granzyme B alongside a 2A-free control (Decision Experiment #3).

nkg2a_vs_nkg2c_2d_synaptic_selectivity_b.biophysical_note: Under mass-action receptor occupancy theta_R = L / (L + K_R) at any shared 2D synaptic HLA-E density L, the odds ratio (theta_A / (1 - theta_A)) / (theta_C / (1 - theta_C)) = K_C / K_A is invariant to L; satisfying theta_A >= 0.50 and theta_C <= 0.20 simultaneously requires K_C / K_A >= 1.0 / 0.25 = 4.0. In soluble 3D SPR of non-covalently refolded HLA-E*01:03 monomers (Lin et al. 2023 Nature Immunology PMID:37264229 Supp. Table 1), VMAPRTLVL (2.10 / 6.52 uM -> K_C / K_A = 3.1048 < 4.0, theta_C = 0.2436; retracting the prior unverified 3.35 / 10.4 uM working placeholder), VMAPRTLIL (1.33 / 4.35 uM -> 3.2707 < 4.0, theta_C = 0.2342; Vales-Gomez et al. 1999 PMID:10428963 Table I reports CD94/NKG2A K_D = 7.35 uM; retracting the prior unverified 2.9 / 17.2 uM citation), and VMAPRTLLL (1.70 / 4.97 uM -> 2.9235 < 4.0, theta_C = 0.2549; retracting the prior un-cited 5.2 / 31.2 uM transposition) all fall below 4.0 in Lin et al. 2023, whereas HLA-G leader VMAPRTLFL achieves K_C / K_A = 5.20 / 0.80 = 6.50x (theta_C = 0.1333) in Kaiser et al. 2008 PMID:18448674 Table 1 and 10.77 / 2.33 = 4.6223x (theta_C = 0.1779) in Vales-Gomez et al. 1999 PMID:10428963 Table I, but is a potent absolute NKG2C agonist (K_C = 5.2-10.8 uM) unless 2D surface density is held within [K_A,2D, 0.25 * K_C,2D]. Moreover, covalently tethering the P9 C-terminus to mature B2M via a 15-20 aa (G4S)3-4 linker alters the P8/P9 F-pocket / CD94-NKG2A/C interface, so 3D soluble monomer ratios cannot be extrapolated to SCTs without direct SPR: Gate 0A-NK (Switch S10) therefore requires monomeric CD94/NKG2A vs CD94/NKG2C SPR and sorted CMV+ NKG2C+NKG2A- adaptive NK lysis screening across the covalent SCT peptide-variant coupon panel (VMAPRTLVL, VMAPRTLFL, VMAPRTLIL, VMAPRTLLL, and P5/P8 selectivity mutants; AUDIT-REF, AUDIT-REF, AUDIT-REF & AUDIT-REF).

native_1efx_1im9_tyr84_kir_asp183_contac.c2_qyddavykl_provenance_and_kir2ds1_sele: QYDDAVYKL in PDB:1IM9 is a synthetic consensus nonamer engineered from HLA-Cw4 pool sequencing (Fan & Wiley 1999 PMID:10429675; Fan et al. 2001 PMID:11323700), not a verified human TUBB self-peptide, and binds activating KIR2DS1 with K_D = 30 uM vs KIR2DL1 K_D = 7.2 uM (Stewart et al. 2005 PMID:16141329; Pittari et al. 2013 PMID:23554313); Gate 0B-SCT therefore requires KIR2DS1-Fc counter-screening and primary sorted KIR2DS1+/KIR2DL1- NK non-activation (CD107a <= 10%, 4-h lysis <= 10%) alongside a verified endogenous HLA-C*04:01 self-peptide challenger (AUDIT-REF, AUDIT-REF & AUDIT-REF).

endogenous_5tm_cd47_tsp1_axis_and_ectodo.endogenous_5tm_cd47_tsp1_gsis_and_surviv: Endogenous chromosome-3 CD47 remains wild-type across Blueprints A*, B'-SCT, and X; while exogenous CD47-IgV-GPI lacks the 5-TM domain required for TSP-1/Cdc42 inhibitory signaling (Xu et al. 2024 PMID:38508139), peri-graft Thrombospondin-1 (TSP-1) secreted by activated platelets/endothelium can engage endogenous 5-TM CD47 to impair beta-cell GSIS and stress survival (Ghimire et al. 2023 PMID:37820008; Kale et al. 2025 PMID:40133488). Decision Experiment #5 therefore includes a recombinant human TSP-1 (1-5 ug/mL) perifusion challenge and an exploratory endogenous CD47 5-TM knockout + pure CD47-IgV-GPI replacement satellite arm.

endogenous_5tm_cd47_tsp1_axis_and_ectodo.qpctl_pyroglutamate_and_opsonized_comple: High-affinity SIRPa recognition of human CD47 requires glutaminyl cyclase (QPCTL)-catalyzed cyclization of mature N-terminal Gln19 (residue 1 after signal-peptide cleavage) into pyroglutamate (pGlu19 / PCA1, which forms direct hydrogen bonds to SIRPa Leu66/Ser66 in PDB:2JJS/4CMM; Logtenberg et al. 2019 Nat Med PMID:30833751). Per Logtenberg et al. 2019 PMID:30833751, antibody CC2C6 recognizes the QPCTL/pGlu19-dependent SIRPa-binding epitope (whose binding is selectively lost upon QPCTL inhibition or SEN177 treatment), whereas B6H12 and 2D3 bind pan-CD47 QPCTL-independent epitopes: Gate 0A-surface therefore quantifies the CC2C6 / B6H12 (and 2D3) MFI ratio (obs_cd47_cc2c6_over_b6h12_ratio >= 0.90) alongside direct recombinant human SIRPa-Fc binding and tryptic N-terminal peptide LC-MS/MS (-17.03 Da pGlu19 vs unmodified Gln19, requiring >= 90% pGlu19 modification) in an isogenic endogenous 5-TM CD47-/- knockout background (so endogenous 5-TM CD47 cannot mask transgenic CD47-IgV-GPI ER processing) across both Stage-7 SC-beta cells and co-transplanted iEC/iPericyte vascular support cells under normoxia, hypoxia (10 mmHg), and cytokine stress, and tests primary human macrophage phagocytosis suppression (obs_complement_c3b_opsonized_phagocytosis_pct <= 5.0% engulfment) under active C3b/iC3b complement + low-titer IgG opsonization where lateral GPI mobility lacks 5-TM cortical actin anchoring (AUDIT-REF, AUDIT-REF, AUDIT-REF & AUDIT-REF).

endogenous_5tm_cd47_tsp1_axis_and_ectodo.inflammatory_protease_and_mmp_ectodomain: In a neutrophil/macrophage-infiltrated graft pocket, neutrophil elastase, cathepsin G, and matrix metalloproteinases (MMP-7, MMP-9, MMP-13; Hira-Miyazawa et al. 2018 PMID:29345283) can cleave the membrane-proximal stalk of PD-L1 or exposed (G4S)4 SCT linkers, both depleting cell-surface checkpoint density and generating soluble sPD-L1/sCD47 decoys; Stage-0 Gate 0A-surface and Gate 0C-kinetic therefore include a 4-h neutrophil elastase (100 nM) + recombinant MMP-7/MMP-9/MMP-13 challenge requiring >=80% surface epitope retention by QuantiBRITE flow and <10% soluble decoy accumulation by ELISA.

hlag1_sct_lilrb1_challenger_and_il12_il1.resting_and_il12_il18_primed_nk_sirpa_he: Resting human peripheral blood NK cells are predominantly SIRPa-negative or SIRPa-low, and while IL-2/IL-15/IFN-alpha priming upregulates SIRPa on a subset of primary NK cells (Deuse et al. 2019 Nat Biotechnol PMID:30778232; Deuse et al. 2021 J Exp Med PMID:33416832), pro-inflammatory IL-12 + IL-18 + IFN-gamma islet pocket stimulation can leave a substantial fraction of KIR2DL+ NKG2A- and KIR2DL- NKG2A- NKG2C+ NK cells with low or variable functional SIRPa surface density. Furthermore, endogenous PD-1 expression on primary human NK cells is minimal or restricted to discrete CMV-experienced subsets (Judge et al. 2020 J Clin Invest PMID:32134744; Davis et al. 2021 Blood Adv PMID:33599743).

hlag1_sct_c42s_lilrb1_kir2dl4_challenger.heavy_chain: HLA-G*01:01 alpha1-alpha3 ectodomain with Cys42Ser (C42S) mutation
hlag1_sct_c42s_lilrb1_kir2dl4_challenger.why_c42s_monomeric_mutant_required: Wild-type HLA-G1 forms disulfide-linked beta2m-associated homodimers via alpha1 Cys42-Cys42 that crosslink LILRB1 (ILT2/CD85j) and myeloid LILRB2 (ILT4) with bivalent sub-micromolar avidity K_D ~ 0.02-0.1 uM (Shiroishi et al. 2003 PNAS PMID:12853576; Shiroishi et al. 2006 J Biol Chem PMID:16455647) but also engage endosomal/surface KIR2DL4 (CD158d), which triggers pro-inflammatory IFN-gamma/chemokine secretion in resting NK cells without cytotoxicity (Rajagopalan & Long 2012 Front Immunol PMID:22934097). sa_thbd_tafi_fibrin_scaffold_versus_ibmi.mechanistic_tradeoff: SA-THBD captures thrombin to activate Protein C (APC) and TAFI (thrombin-activatable fibrinolysis inhibitor; Bajzar et al. 1996 PMID:8663147); while high local SA-THBD suppresses IBMIR and TAFIa stabilizes fibrin matrices against plasmin, excessive thrombin sequestration during Day 0-3 can impair initial fibrinogen-to-fibrin polymerization required for endothelial sprouting or over-stabilize fibrin via TAFIa to block plasmin/MMP remodeling during tubulogenesis, whereas insufficient local anticoagulation risks microvascular thrombosis inside anastomosing iEC/pericyte lumens (Weaver et al. 2019 PMID:30378751; Coronel et al. 2020 PMID:32923626; Aghazadeh et al. 2021 PMID:34480863).
three_assay_orthogonal_gate_0f_fibrin_pa: Single common formulation dose rule: a single selected SA-THBD surface-equivalent dose d* (titrated across 0, 50, 150, 300 nM across n >= 6 independent blood/iEC donors) must simultaneously clear Assays 1, 2, 2b, and 3 without dose-splitting between rheology and whole-blood patency.
Assay 1 (Chandler-loop IBMIR suppression at dose d*): recalcified human whole-blood loop requiring upper95(TAT) <= 15 ug/L, upper95(C3a) <= 200 ng/mL, and lower95(platelet retention) >= 85%.

Assay 2 (7-day iEC/pericyte fibrin-sprouting rheometry & tubulogenesis at dose d*): fibrinogen (2.5-5.0 mg/mL) + physiological thrombin (0.5-2.0 U/mL), requiring fibrin storage modulus G' within 80-120% of unmodified fibrin control and Day-7 CD31+ lumenized vascular network length lower95 >= 85% of control.

Assay 2b (TAFIa & APC chromogenic kinetics and tPA clot-lysis remodeling window at dose d*): direct chromogenic measurement of APC and TAFIa generation plus tPA-induced (100 ng/mL) turbidimetric clot-lysis half-time t_1/2 required to remain within 0.80x-1.50x of unmodified fibrin control with >= 80% pericellular fibrin remodeling clearance around sprouting iEC lumens at Day 7 (preventing TAFIa fibrinolytic lock).

Assay 3 (Perfused microvascular lumen patency under recalcified human whole blood at dose d*): microfluidic vascularized hydrogel perfusion after anastomosis requiring lower95(70-kDa FITC-dextran / autologous RBC perfused lumen fraction) >= 90% at 24 h without occlusive fibrin/platelet microthrombi and tracer-clearance-derived perfusion rate constant lower95(k_perf) >= 0.10 s^-1 (matching Layer-4 Gate 0F obs_outer_band_kperf_s_inv >= 0.10 s^-1).
